title: March of the Machine: card flavor text

entities.name: Elspeth

events.summary: Elspeth shines like a sixth sun, inspiring hope in the Mirrans and terror in New Phyrexia.
events.quote: Elspeth shone like a sixth sun, inspiring hope in the Mirrans and terror in New Phyrexia.

events.summary: Tamiyo's story ends with one swift, merciful stroke.
events.quote: With one swift, merciful stroke, Tamiyo's story came to an end.

events.summary: Elspeth's light pierces Elesh Norn, whose nightmare becomes flesh.
events.quote: Elesh Norn screamed as the light pierced her. Her nightmare had become flesh.

events.summary: Phyrexia's progress on Gobakhan is hampered by diamond storms until it recruits shieldmages.
events.quote: The diamond storms of Gobakhan hampered Phyrexia's progress until they recruited some of the local shieldmages.

events.summary: The weight of Phyrexia crashes down on Gobakhan, but its people's will endures.
events.quote: The weight of Phyrexia crashed down upon Gobakhan, but the will of its people endured.

events.summary: Quintorius watches Professor Pitnik, now a Phyrexian, confiscate a historical tome.
events.quote: Quintorius muffled a sob as he watched the thing that was once Professor Pitnik "confiscate" yet another priceless historical tome.

events.summary: Seraph of New Capenna begins to change after her Halo reserves are exhausted, vowing to bless the plane with 'perfection.'
events.quote: With her Halo reserves exhausted, she began to change, and she made a new promise to bless New Capenna with glistening perfection.

events.summary: Elspeth makes a choice on the precipice of eternity to continue the fight.
events.quote: On the precipice of eternity, Elspeth made a choice. The fight would not end without her.

events.summary: Teferi, Karn and Melira each help the defenders; Melira pays the ultimate price to free Ajani.
events.quote: But it was Melira who paid the ultimate price to free Ajani from Phyrexia's grasp.

events.summary: Wrenn reaches out to Teferi across the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: Wrenn reached out to Teferi through the Blind Eternities, and an impossible connection flared across the vast emptiness.

events.summary: As harvesters carry away Urabrask, Elesh Norn says 'Leave the traitor be.'
events.quote: As the harvesters bore away the last of his limbs, what remained of Urabrask heard Elesh Norn say, "Leave the traitor be."

events.summary: New Phyrexia phases out of existence, cutting off the oil and felling the compleated invaders.
events.quote: As New Phyrexia phased out of existence, glistening oil all across the Multiverse was cut off from its source.

events.summary: Atraxa arrives at New Capenna, is welcomed, and then the slaughter begins.
events.quote: When Atraxa first arrived, the people of New Capenna rejoiced at the sight of such a grand angel. Then the slaughter began.

events.summary: Chandra and Wrenn go in blazing as the rest of the Gatewatch retreats.
events.quote: The rest of the Gatewatch retreated. Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.

events.summary: Warriors of Kaldheim burn the soul of their world to keep it from Phyrexia.
events.quote: The warriors of Kaldheim burned the soul of their world to keep it out of Phyrexia's hands.

events.summary: Nahiri's rage shatters hedrons into burning ruin.
events.quote: Nahiri's rage shattered hedrons into deadly, burning ruin.

events.summary: Wrenn bends Realmbreaker to her will even as she burns.
events.quote: Even as she burned, Wrenn bent Realmbreaker to her will.

events.summary: Nahiri tries to bend Zendikar to Phyrexia's will, and the world rises against her.
events.quote: Nahiri tried to bend Zendikar to Phyrexia's will. In response, the world rose against her.

events.summary: Wrenn gave everything and asked for nothing.
events.quote: Wrenn had given everything and asked for nothing.

events.summary: The Roil rises against Phyrexian infection on Zendikar.
events.quote: The Roil, Zendikar's planewide immune system, rose in full force against the threat of Phyrexian infection.

events.summary: Elesh Norn dispatches Atraxa to bring New Capenna to heel after learning of its Halo supply.
events.quote: Having learned of New Capenna's Halo supply, Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa herself to bring the world to heel.

events.summary: Norn defiles Serra's temples with monuments to Phyrexia.
events.quote: Serra was a symbol of hope to Dominaria, so Norn defiled her temples with monuments to Phyrexia.

events.summary: Multani greets Yargle, saying his daughter has shown him the merit in Urborg's ways.
events.quote: "I've heard much about you from my daughter," Multani rumbled.

events.summary: Two titans of Tarkir carve through Phyrexia's elite.
events.quote: Two titans of Tarkir carved a swath through Phyrexia's elite.

relations.quote: Elesh Norn dispatched Atraxa herself to bring the world to heel.
Kaladesh's wondrous inventions and glowing aether were of utmost interest to Jin-Gitaxias and his Chrome Host.
Chandra and Wrenn went in blazing.
